name: Wavelength
description: Consultant-led point-of-care ultrasound courses for emergency and acute clinicians. Small-group, hands-on teaching mapped to the RCEM curriculum.

director.name: Dr Firas Abou-Auda
director.title: Consultant in Emergency Medicine
bio: Firas is a Consultant in Emergency Medicine and the Ultrasound Lead at Darent Valley Hospital in Kent. He supervises clinicians through the FAMUS accreditation pathway and has used point-of-care ultrasound in emergency care for more than a decade.

He sits on the EUSEM Ultrasound Committee and the Emergency Ultrasound Curriculum Task Force, and he examines for and writes content for the European Board Examination in Emergency Medicine. He is an ALS and ATLS instructor.

team.name: Dr Zahra Habibzadeh
team.title: Ultrasonographer and Emergency Clinical Specialist
bio: Zahra is an experienced ultrasonographer and emergency clinical specialist, with years of hands-on scanning in acute and emergency care.
As General Manager she runs Wavelength day to day, from course planning and venues to bookings and delegate support, and brings a sonographer's eye for image quality to every course.
